title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Shin Oishinbo' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya 's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo , announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara TV Anime Reveals Main Cast, Staff, January Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of writer Juntarō Aoki and artist Shin Moriyama 's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara ( Getting Shots on a Frying Pan or Nabetama for short) manga opened on Thursday and revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, main cast, main staff members, and January debut.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Wandance Film's New Video Previews Insert Song by mabanua
content: The official website for the live-action film of Coffee 's Wandance manga began streaming a new video featuring the insert song "Step by Step feat. Sagiri Sól , Kenya Fujita " by mabanua , on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: 'Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content: Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Juntarou Aoki and Shin Moriyama 's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara ( Getting Shots on Frying Pan ) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Chained Soldier Manga Resumes on December 12
content: This is a delay from the manga's originally planned resumption on November 14, but the announcement stated the new date was decided after taking Takemura's health into account. The manga went on hiatus in October due to artist Takemura's poor health.
author: ANN

title: Resident Evil Requiem Wins Golden Joystick Awards' Ultimate Game of the Year, Console Game of the Year
content: The Golden Joystick 2026 ceremony announced this year's awards on Wednesday. CAPCOM 's Resident Evil Requiem game won the Ultimate Game of the Year award, as well as Console Game of the Year. Angela Sant'Albano also won Best Lead Performer for her performance as protagonist Grace Ashcroft in Resident Evil Reqiuem .
author: ANN

title: Viz Media Licenses Kyousuke Motomi's Registry of the Divine Manga
content: Viz Media announced on Wednesday that it has licensed Kyousuke Motomi 's Registry of the Divine ( Yaoyoruzu Toriatsukai Setsumeisho ) manga and will begin releasing it in English on the Viz Manga app on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Rei Mikamoto Ends Blood Friend Manga in December
content: The December issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Beam magazine announced on Thursday that Rei Mikamoto will end the Blood Friend manga in the next issue on December 11. The violent horror manga is set in an old western-style mansion rumored to be haunted, on the outskirts of a town.
author: ANN

title: Duel Masters GT Manga's Part 3 Ends
content: Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga released the final chapter of Hiroki Kikuzuma and Daisuke Kawasaki 's Duel Masters GT3 -Glitch of the Twin heart- , the third part of their Duel Masters GT manga, in early access on Wednesday. The chapter will release publicly on November 18.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Has a Much Better First Impression
content: The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime now airing its episodes through the Fall, and a new update has revealed just how long Devils’ Crest is going to be sticking around for.
author: ComicBook
